repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
triggered := false
if (triggered == true) {
wait until(any(#TemperatureSensor).temperatureSensor_temperature < 30)
triggered = false
}
wait until(any(#TemperatureSensor).temperatureSensor_temperature >= 30)
all(#WindowCovering).windowCovering_downOrClose()
triggered = true

diagnosis.summary: The IR requires a rising-edge wait on a slot declared as 'any' (existential). The candidate used 'all' (universal) in the wait condition, causing it to block until BOTH devices dropped below 30, whereas the IR only waits until ONE device rises to 30. F2 confirms the JoI missed the action because the universal condition was not met at t=0 (Bedroom_Temp was null/unknown), while the IR would have fired immediately based on Living_Temp.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed the wait condition from 'all' to 'any' (using the '|' suffix) to match the existential quantifier of the binding slot. This allows the rising edge to trigger as soon as any single sensor meets the condition, preserving the IR's behavior.
